steps.body: To subtract across ten, stop at ten on the way down. 15 − 7: take 5 to reach ten, then 2 more.
steps.narration: To subtract across ten, stop at ten on the way down. 15 − 7: take 5 to reach ten, then 2 more.

widget.prompt: Start at 15 and hop back 5 to reach ten.

commonLandings.feedback: That is one hop too far. Five hops back from 15 lands exactly on ten.
That is one hop short of ten. Count all five hops back.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 15 and make 5 hops left, one number at a time.
widget.successFeedback: Five hops back from 15 lands on ten — the halfway stop.

predict.prompt: 15 − 7: after stepping down to ten, how much is still to take?
predict.reveal: 5 of the 7 gets you to ten; 2 remain, so the answer is 8.

explanationVariants: Take 5 to reach ten, then 2 more: 15 − 7 = 8.
Subtracting in two steps keeps every step inside facts already known.
